name: fastify-billing
description: Monorepo untuk backend API dan frontend billing

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --prefix fasty-api" "npm run dev --prefix fasty-bill"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix fasty-api && npm run build --prefix fasty-bill
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run start --prefix fasty-api" "npm run preview --prefix fasty-bill"
